message-scroller.name: TeamChat
message-scroller.title: Team chat
message-scroller.description: A team channel. New messages rise in, and at the end the view follows them. Scroll up and it holds still while the arrow offers the latest; send a message and the view jumps to it.

message-scroller.name: MessageScrollerHistory
message-scroller.title: Loading earlier messages
message-scroller.description: Earlier messages load above the ones in view, and the reader's place does not move.
